original_acceptance: Each selected probe names the missing fact it supplies and a versioned approved capability.
The planner does not claim the missing fact was collected or the finding resolved.
No claim of reduced cost or better decisions precedes measured comparisons with denominators.
Every listed artifact exists or has an agreed equivalent path, and an independent reviewer can reproduce the documented procedure.
Record actual tests, input/configuration revisions and unresolved failures; planned/reference examples do not establish completion.

asset_research_plan.decision: Map structured missing asset-field keys to approved read-only collection probes and choose a bounded plan under a declared cost/budget, with a reason for each requested fact.
questions: Which approved probe supplies each asset field, and which fields cannot be collected in the current scope?
Can deterministic coverage/cost rules reduce unnecessary collection versus always running full inventory?
How should stale evidence, missing permissions, identity conflict and exhausted budgets prevent or limit a plan?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Compare full inventory, fixed rules and budget-aware selection on the same reviewed gap fixtures, including negative results.
cases: Unknown/mutating commands and denied target scopes produce no executable collection plan.
Enforce the declared budget and prevent duplicate probes for equivalent requirements.
Measure resolved evidence gaps, unresolved gaps and cost on the same cases for each baseline.
consumers: C21: version-bound approved probe plans to turn into bounded collection intents.
C22: selected/rejected probes and costs for baseline/ablation comparison.
A11/P08 reviewers: optional structured plan consumption and existing typed-envelope validation; no AI or executor ownership transfer.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous reviews gap semantics and baseline outcomes; Omar reviews typed-envelope compatibility and denied operations.
asset_research_plan.start: Post-first-slice: complete C19, D08, P08 first; draft research/fixtures earlier without claiming measured completion.
